payload.core_mechanism_summary: The code tries each of the three notes as the first in ordering, computes semitone distances to the other two, and checks if it matches major (4,7) or minor (3,7) patterns, then prints result.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly enumerates the three possible cyclic orderings of the input notes to check chord conditions, which is a brute-force permutation enumeration over a tiny fixed set.
